title: Child
description: A parent-child link. The component carries no value: the name of the reference is a selector naming the child -- a node id such as #11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111, or a CSS-flavoured selector such as '.mesh', '[name="Brick"]' or 'DamagedHelmet.glb|.mesh'. A selector may match several nodes, and each match becomes a child, so one node can hold many children and a later section can drop a single link with a DELETE on that name.
